title: Five Stars
text: Five Stars. Love the finish of these hooks I bought for our laundry room closet!

product_metadata.title: OrganizeCity Heavy Duty Double Prong Coat and Hat Hook with Ball Tip, 5 Pack (Screws Included) Wall Mount, Oil Rubbed Bronze- 1 ¾’’ x 2 ¾’’ x 1’’

Double prong- holds 2 or more items. Mounting hardware included-mount anywhere.
Ideal use for bedroom, closet, bathroom, entryway, coats, backpacks, keys...
Overall Dimensions: 1 ¾’’ x 2 ¾’’ x 1’’ (at base). Decorative ball tip design.
Comes in different color as well. Search asin number: B01KYC8YZ6
